events.comment:
PROJECT ZERO — โค้ดหลักของเกม (JavaScript)
บล็อกด้านล่างทำงานครั้งเดียวตอนเริ่มฉาก Loading แล้วสร้าง window.P2050 ไว้ใช้ทั้งเกม
• Data = ข้อความ TH/EN, ภูมิภาค, ผังเทคโนโลยี, เหตุการณ์ 152 เรื่อง, ข่าว, คู่มือ, ความสำเร็จ (แก้ตัวเลข/ข้อความได้ที่นี่)
• Engine = กติกาการจำลองรายเดือน (เหมือนเวอร์ชันเว็บทุกอย่าง)
• UI/Screens = วาดหน้าจอด้วยออบเจกต์ UIPainter, UIText, UIIcon, TutImage
ส่วนจังหวะเวลา การคลิก คีย์บอร์ด ดนตรี และการเปลี่ยนฉาก อยู่ใน Events ของแต่ละฉาก

"Training mode: learn step by step by really playing, about 8 minutes. New players start here, and it can be replayed from the menu.",

"Bug fixes: over 100 countries (such as Somalia, Fiji and the Maldives) showed no disaster warnings or aid bubbles · mineral icons were blank on some devices (there is a fallback now) · some text was hidden behind the ability bar."

const P = window.P2050 = window.P2050 || {};
if (P.mods && P.mods.engine) return;
(P.mods = P.mods || {}).engine = 1;
Engine · Simulation
One tick = one in-game month. The scene's "tick" timer calls P.tick().
Regions hold the totals; each region is split into countries (+ one pooled
"other countries" entry) so CO₂ can be cut country by country.
Everything visual goes through the hooks in P.H (set by the UI/Map/Audio modules).
const {UI, MONTHS, RESERVE, REGIONS, RIDS, RMETA, CITIES, ACTIONS, SKILLS, SKILL, SKILL_CATS, EVENTS, NEWS, ACH, IC,
COUNTRIES, COUNTRY, REST_W, HAZARDS, CEVENTS, CE_FIXED, CHARS, CHAR, STORY, levelOf} = P;
const H = P.H = P.H || {};
const hook = (name, ...a) => (H[name] ? H[name](...a) : undefined);

const t = k => (UI[k] ? UI[k][S.lang || "th"] : k);
const L = o => (o && typeof o === "object" ? o[S.lang || "th"] : o);

const TOTAL_TICKS = 300;
const TIP_TO_TEMP = 0.004;          // 1 'tipping %' ≈ +0.004 °C
const SPEEDS = [0, 9, 4.5, 3];      // seconds per month: 1× ≈ 45 min for the whole game, 2× ≈ 22 min, 3× ≈ 15 min
const MAX_PROJECTS = 3;
const MODES = {normal:{ep:25, pc:20, haz:1, dmg:1}, hard:{ep:10, pc:12, haz:1.3, dmg:1.2}, daily:{ep:25, pc:20, haz:1.1, dmg:1}};
/* Balance presets: inc = monthly income · cost = prices of skills and orders · haz = how often disasters come · growth = how fast emissions grow.
Bot test (tools/sim.mjs, with the seasons since 2.1.3): with A a sensible player wins ~25% as the Scientist and 30–55%
with the other characters (caps: Scientist ≤40%, others ≤60%), mostly in 2048–2050, and most of their losses are
near misses that run out of time; B = harder still. Players get A; B is for testing during development.
2.1.3: was {inc:1, cost:1.1, haz:1, growth:1}, which a sensible player won every time once the season rewards came in. */
const BALANCE = {A:{inc:.88, cost:1.25, haz:1.09, growth:1.045}, B:{inc:.85, cost:1.3, haz:1.15, growth:1.06}};
const HARD = {inc:1, cost:.975, haz:1.1, growth:1};   // Hard Core on top of the preset
const bal = () => { const b = BALANCE[S.ab] || BALANCE.A; return S.mode === "hard" ? {inc:b.inc * HARD.inc, cost:b.cost * HARD.cost, haz:b.haz * HARD.haz, growth:b.growth * HARD.growth} : b; };
function setBalance(id, values){ if (values) BALANCE[id] = Object.assign({inc:1, cost:1, haz:1, growth:1}, values); if (S) S.ab = BALANCE[id] ? id : "A"; }
/* Every game uses preset A. Developers can try another preset with ?ab=B in the address or localStorage "p2050-ab" (bot tests: web/tools/sim.mjs). */
function pickBalance(){
let k = null;
try { k = (typeof location !== "undefined" && new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("ab")) || (typeof localStorage !== "undefined" && localStorage.getItem("p2050-ab")); } catch(e){}
return k && BALANCE[k] ? k : "A";
/* ---------------------------- Random numbers (seeded, so a Daily Challenge is the same for everyone) ---------------------------- */
function rand(){ let x = (S.rng = (S.rng + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0); x = Math.imul(x ^ (x >>> 15), x | 1); x ^= x + Math.imul(x ^ (x >>> 7), x | 61); return ((x ^ (x >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296; }
const randSeed = () => (Math.random() * 2 ** 31) | 0;
function newState(lang, o = {}){
const mode = MODES[o.mode] ? o.mode : "normal", M = MODES[mode];
const st = {
v:SAVE_VERSION, lang: lang || "th", mode, simple:mode === "fast" ? 1 : 0, char:CHAR[o.char] ? o.char : "sci", charLv:o.charLv || 1, seed:o.seed ?? randSeed(), rng:0,
speed:1, tick:0, realSec:0,

countries:[], selC:null, haz:[], hazId:0, actCd:{}, buff:{}, bond:0, alli:{}, bilats:[], roles:{}, evacFree:{},

story:{}, cev:null,
hist:[{net:36, temp:1.2}], log:[],

function buildCountries(){
S.countries = [];
for (const r of S.regions){
const list = COUNTRIES.filter(c => c.reg === r.id), tot = list.reduce((s, c) => s + c.w, 0) + REST_W[r.id];
for (const c of list){
const rel = Math.round(Math.max(-60, Math.min(70, c.stance * 30 + 10 + (rand() - .5) * 16)));
S.countries.push({id:c.id, reg:r.id, co2:r.co2 * c.w / tot, co2_0:r.co2 * c.w / tot, rel, adapt:0, cd:{}});
S.countries.push({id:"R_" + r.id, reg:r.id, rest:true, co2:r.co2 * REST_W[r.id] / tot, co2_0:r.co2 * REST_W[r.id] / tot, rel:10, adapt:0, cd:{}});
function resetState(o){ Object.keys(S).forEach(k => delete S[k]); Object.assign(S, o); }
const clamp = (v,a,b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v));
const R = id => S.regions.find(r => r.id === id);
const C = id => S.countries.find(c => c.id === id);
const regCountries = (reg, withRest = true) => S.countries.filter(c => c.reg === reg && (withRest || !c.rest));
const avg = f => S.regions.reduce((s,r) => s + f(r), 0) / S.regions.length;
const grossCO2 = () => S.regions.reduce((s,r) => s + r.co2, 0) + (S.seasCO2 || 0);   // 3.7.3: + this month's seasonal swing (40-seasons.js)
const sinkEff = () => clamp(1 - Math.max(0, S.temp - 1.2) * 0.3, 0.5, 1);
const netCO2 = () => grossCO2() - S.sink * sinkEff();
const lastMile = r => 0.2 + 0.8 * clamp(r.co2 / r.co2_0, 0, 1);
const dateStr = (tk = S.tick) => `${MONTHS[S.lang][tk % 12]} ${2026 + Math.floor(tk / 12)}`;
const fmt = (v,d=1) => (v > 0 ? "+" : v < 0 ? "−" : "") + Math.abs(v).toFixed(d);
const pick = (arr, w) => { let s = arr.reduce((a,x) => a + w(x), 0), r = rand() * s; for (const x of arr){ r -= w(x); if (r <= 0) return x; } return arr[arr.length-1]; };
const cname = id => { if (!id) return ""; if (id.startsWith("R_")) return `${t("otherIn")} ${L(RMETA[id.slice(2)].name)}`; return L(COUNTRY[id].name); };
const joinNames = ids => { const n = ids.map(cname); if (n.length < 2) return n.join(""); return n.slice(0, -1).join(", ") + ` ${t("and")} ` + n[n.length - 1]; };
function addLog(txt, cls=""){ S.log.unshift({tk:S.tick, txt, cls}); if (S.log.length > 150) S.log.pop(); }
/* region totals = sum of their countries; a change to a whole region is shared out in proportion */
function syncRegion(r){ r.co2 = regCountries(r.id).reduce((s, c) => s + c.co2, 0); }
function setRegionCO2(r, v){
v = Math.max(0, v); const old = r.co2, list = regCountries(r.id);
if (old > 1e-9) list.forEach(c => c.co2 *= v / old); else { const tot = list.reduce((s, c) => s + c.co2_0, 0) || 1; list.forEach(c => c.co2 = v * c.co2_0 / tot); }
r.co2 = v;
function addCountryCO2(c, d){ c.co2 = Math.max(0, c.co2 + d); syncRegion(R(c.reg)); }
function applyGlobalCO2(delta){ const g = grossCO2() || 1; S.regions.forEach(r => applyRegionCO2(r, delta * (r.co2 / g))); }
function applyRegionCO2(r, delta){ const d = delta < 0 ? delta * (r.comp / 100) * lastMile(r) : delta; setRegionCO2(r, r.co2 + d); }
function changeComp(id, v, permanent){ (id === "ALL" ? S.regions : [R(id)]).forEach(r => { r.comp = clamp(r.comp + v, 0, 100); if (permanent) r.compBase = clamp(r.compBase + v, 0, 100); }); }
function changeVuln(id, v){ (id === "ALL" ? S.regions : [R(id)]).forEach(r => { r.vuln = clamp(r.vuln + v, 0, 100); }); }
const charLvBonus = () => S.charLv >= 3;
const REL_COMP = .3;   // 1.1: how much a continent's friendship pulls its on-plan % (was .08)
function relMult(){ let m = 1; if (S.owned.D1) m += .2; if (S.char === "dip") m += .04; return m; }
function changeRel(id, v){
const c = C(id); if (!c) return 0;
const d = v > 0 ? v * relMult() : v, before = c.rel;
c.rel = clamp(c.rel + d, -100, 100);
if (c.rel >= 100) Ach.unlock("rel100");
return c.rel - before;
const avgRel = reg => { const l = regCountries(reg, false); return l.length ? l.reduce((s, c) => s + c.rel, 0) / l.length : 0; };
const relAll = () => { const l = S.countries.filter(c => !c.rest); return l.reduce((s, c) => s + c.rel, 0) / l.length; };
/* 1.1: approval is easy to lose and slow to win back */
const APPR_UP = .7, APPR_DOWN = 1.2;
function addAppr(v){ S.appr = clamp(S.appr + (v > 0 ? v * APPR_UP : v * APPR_DOWN), 0, 100); }
function epGain(){
let base = 1 + avg(r => r.comp) * 0.05 + S.appr / 40 + (S.bilats || []).length * (P.BILAT_INC || 0);
if (S.char === "eco") base *= charLvBonus() ? 1.06 : 1.05;
return Math.floor((Math.floor(base) + S.epInc) * bal().inc * (1 + (S.prest || 0) * .03) * (P.incMult ? P.incMult() : 1));   // 1.6: industry's mood   // prest: Prestige stars (Continuous World only)

const pcGain = () => Math.max(1, Math.floor((1.3 + avg(r => r.comp) * 0.035 + (S.pcInc || 0)) * bal().inc * (P.pcMult ? P.pcMult() : 1)));   // 1.6: the young's mood   // pcInc: home base (Continuous World)
const recentBuys = () => (S.buys || []).filter(tk => S.tick - tk < 12).length;
const rushMult = () => 1 + 0.2 * recentBuys();
function nodeCost(n){
let m = (S.disc[n.id] ?? 1) * S.discAll * rushMult() * bal().cost;

/* ---- cloud saves: the 3 slots follow the account. Each write here is sent up a few seconds later.
The slots on this device are tagged with their account (p2050-saves-owner; none = guest):
- same account → per slot the newer copy wins, both ways (one account on several devices)
- guest or another account's slots → the account's cloud slots win. Guest games only move into slots the
account has free (and are sent up); the guest set is kept aside (p2050-saves-guest) and comes back on sign-out.
A deleted slot is kept as a "deleted at" marker. A failed sync changes nothing and is tried again. ---- */
cloudQueue(slot){
if (!this.user || ls.get(OWNER) !== this.user.username) return;   // not merged with this account yet: loadCloud sends it
(this._sq = this._sq || {})[slot] = 1; clearTimeout(this._sqT);
this._sqT = setTimeout(() => { const q = Object.keys(this._sq); this._sq = {}; q.forEach(k => this.cloudPush(k)); }, 6000);
async cloudPush(slot){
if (!this.user) return false;
const all = P.rawSaves(), s = all && all[slot]; if (!s || !s.meta) return false;
try { await this.req("PUT", `/saves/${slot}`, {meta:s.meta, state:s.S || {}}); return true; }
catch(e){ if (e.error !== "unauthorized"){ clearTimeout(this._pushT); this._pushT = setTimeout(() => this.cloudPush(slot), 20000); } return false; }
/* one sync at a time; a call during a sync runs it once more afterwards (was dropped before) */
loadCloud(){
if (!this.user) return Promise.resolve();
if (this._syncing){ this._again = true; return this._syncing; }
this._syncing = (async () => { do { this._again = false; await this.syncSaves(); } while (this._again && this.user); })()
.finally(() => { this._syncing = null; dirty(); });
return this._syncing;
async syncSaves(){
const me = this.user && this.user.username; if (!me) return;
const retry = () => { clearTimeout(this._cloudT); this._cloudT = setTimeout(() => this.loadCloud(), 15000); };
const playing = S.started && !S.over && P.UIM && P.UIM.screen === "game";
const owner = ls.get(OWNER), mine = owner === me;
if (!mine && playing) return;   // takes over the slots: wait until back at the menu (game.js refreshes there)
let cloud; try { cloud = await this.req("GET", "/saves") || {}; } catch(e){ if (e.error !== "unauthorized") retry(); return; }
const all = P.rawSaves() || {}, out = {}, push = [];
const fetchSlot = async slot => { const j = await this.req("GET", `/saves/${slot}`); return j && j.state && P.validSave(j.state) ? {meta:j.meta, S:j.state} : null; };
try {
for (const slot of P.SLOTS){
const c = cloud[slot] && cloud[slot].meta, l = all[slot] && all[slot].meta;
const newerC = c && (!l || (c.at || 0) > (l.at || 0)), sameGame = c && l && c.id && c.id === l.id;
if (mine || sameGame){
if (newerC){
if (playing && S.saveSlot === slot){ out[slot] = all[slot]; continue; }   // never swap the game being played
out[slot] = c.del ? {meta:c, S:null} : (await fetchSlot(slot)) || all[slot] || null;
} else { out[slot] = all[slot] || null; if (l && (!c || (l.at || 0) > (c.at || 0))) push.push(slot); }
} else out[slot] = c && !c.del ? await fetchSlot(slot) : null;   // the account's slot wins
} catch(e){ if (e.error !== "unauthorized") retry(); return; }   // nothing changed yet
if (!mine){
const live = sv => sv && sv.meta && !sv.meta.del && sv.S && P.validSave(sv.S);
const placed = new Set(P.SLOTS.map(k => out[k] && out[k].meta && out[k].meta.id).filter(Boolean));
if (owner === null){
if (P.SLOTS.some(k => live(all[k]))) ls.set(GUEST, JSON.stringify(all));   // put the guest set aside
// guest games move into the account's free slots, newest first
const left = P.SLOTS.filter(k => live(all[k]) && !placed.has(all[k].meta.id)).sort((x, y) => (all[y].meta.at || 0) - (all[x].meta.at || 0));
for (const k of left){ const free = P.SLOTS.find(x => !live(out[x])); if (!free) break; out[free] = all[k]; push.push(free); }
// another account's slots stay in that account's cloud
P.putSaves(out); ls.set(OWNER, me); this.fixSlot(out);
this.cloud = cloud;
for (const k of push) this.cloudPush(k);

const relFactor = rel => rel >= 50 ? 1 : rel >= 20 ? .6 : rel >= 0 ? .3 : 0;
const ORE_HOME = .25, ORE_SRC = .024;   // 1.1: much less free income (was .6 and .035) · 3.7.5: countries send 50% more (.016 → .024)
/* what each country sends us this month: [{id, amt}] */
function oreSources(){
const out = [];
for (const c of S.countries){
const cr = CRES[c.id]; if (!cr || !cr.w || c.rest) continue;
if ((S.oreBan || {})[c.id] > 0) continue;
const amt = cr.w * relFactor(c.rel) * ORE_SRC;
if (amt > 0) out.push({id:c.id, amt});
return out;
function oreGain(){
if (!S.oreOn) return 0;
let g = ORE_HOME + oreSources().reduce((s, x) => s + x.amt, 0) + (S.oreInc || 0);
if ((S.orePrice || 0) > 0) g *= .7;                // price spike: the market sends less for the same money
return Math.max(0, Math.round(g * 10) / 10);
const oreDisc = () => Math.max(.5, 1 - (S.oreDisc || 0));
function oreCost(n){
if (!n.ore || !S.oreOn) return 0;
return Math.round(n.ore * oreDisc() * (S.orePrice > 0 ? 1.3 : 1) * (P.balanceCost ? P.balanceCost() : 1));
function oreTick(){
if (!S.oreOn) return;
const src = oreSources(), base = ORE_HOME + (S.oreInc || 0), tot = oreGain();
S.ore = (S.ore || 0) + tot;
const from = S.oreFrom = S.oreFrom || {};
src.forEach(x => { from[x.id] = (from[x.id] || 0) + x.amt; });
from.home = (from.home || 0) + base;

Object.keys(S.oreBan || {}).forEach(k => { if (S.oreBan[k] > 0 && --S.oreBan[k] === 0){ P.addLog(`[[${"package-open"}]] ${P.cname(k)} ${L(T("กลับมาส่งออกทรัพยากรแล้ว", "is exporting minerals again"))}`, "gd"); } });
if (S.orePrice > 0) S.orePrice--;
// orange bubbles over mining countries
if (!S.bubbles.some(b => b.type === "ore") && P.rand() < .14){
const list = S.countries.filter(c => CRES[c.id] && CRES[c.id].w && !(S.oreBan || {})[c.id]);
if (list.length){ const c = list[Math.floor(P.rand() * list.length)]; S.bubbles.push({id:++S.bubId, type:"ore", reg:c.reg, cid:c.id, ttl:4}); hook("sfx", "spawnGreen"); }

Version 1.6 · Politics at home: four groups of people, each with its own satisfaction
· A group "backs you" at 70%+ and at least 6 points above the average; it is "very angry" below 25%.
· Industry, farmers, young people and city people. Approval = their weighted average.
· Every approval change still reaches everyone (the tuned balance is kept), but skills,
event choices and orders also tilt the groups: a carbon tax angers industry and pleases
the young, alternative protein angers farmers, and so on (tilts never change the average).
· Each group matters in its own way:
industry  → income (up to ±10% compared with the others), money +2/mo when it backs you, strikes when it is angry
farmers   → soil carbon when they back you, road blockades when angry
young     → policy points (up to ±10%), +1/mo when they back you, school strikes when angry
city      → approval +0.1/mo when it backs you, riots when angry
· Tilts fade slowly towards the average, so a group can be won back.

· Minerals dug out of the ground are RAW: skills can only use REFINED minerals.
· Raw minerals go through refineries: our own (a small one to start with, more can be built)
and those of friendly countries that refine (toll refining: friendship 40+ lends capacity).
· Countries that refine a group (China above all) send it ready to use; other producers send it raw.
· The world market sells refined minerals; it is the quick but dear way round.
· A refinery costs money to build, a little every month to run, pleases industry and annoys city people.
Real-world basis: IEA "Global Critical Minerals Outlook" — China refines most of the world's
graphite, rare earths, cobalt, lithium and polysilicon; Indonesia most nickel.

/* what a panel says / who says it, for this game (lines can depend on the character or on what happened) */

P.panelSay = p => { let s = typeof p.say === "function" ? p.say() : p.say; if (s && !s.th && (s[S.char] || s["*"])) s = s[S.char] || s["*"]; const v = S.sceneVars || {}; return {th:(s.th || "").replace(/\{(\w)\}/g, (m, k) => v[k] ?? m), en:(s.en || "").replace(/\{(\w)\}/g, (m, k) => v[k] ?? m)}; };
P.panelWho = p => (typeof p.who === "function" ? p.who() : p.who);
/* 2.3: who reads a panel aloud (the recorded narration has one voice per person) */
P.narrWho = p => { const w = P.panelWho(p); return w === "me" ? S.char : (w || "adv"); };
/* one scene at a time, never in the same month as a new disaster forecast, a story act or an event, and at least 4 months apart */
function sceneTick(){
if (S.over || S.event || S.world || S.training || S.simple) return;
if ((P.UIM && P.UIM.modal) || S.haz.some(h => h.at === S.tick + P.FORECAST)) return;
if (S.tick - (S.lastScene ?? -99) < 4) return;
const sc = SCENES.find(x => !S.story[x.act] && x.when()); if (!sc) return;
S.story[sc.act] = 1; S.lastScene = S.tick; S.sceneVars = sc.vars ? sc.vars() : {};
hook("story", sc.act);
/* ---------------- milestones: net CO₂ targets on the way to 2050 ---------------- */
const MS_REWARD = {ep:25, pc:6};
P.MILESTONES = MS; P.MS_REWARD = MS_REWARD;
function milestoneTick(){
if (S.world || S.over || S.v2) return;   // 2.0: games started in 2.0 get a yearly review instead (37-v20.js)
MS.forEach((m, i) => {
if (S.ms17[i] !== undefined || S.tick < m.tk) return;
const net = P.netCO2(), hit = net <= m.v;
if (hit){ S.ep += MS_REWARD.ep; S.pc += MS_REWARD.pc; if (P.ledgerTag) P.ledgerTag("event", MS_REWARD.ep, MS_REWARD.pc); }

P.addLog(`[[${hit ? "flag" : "flag-off"}]] ${L(T("เป้าหมายปี", "Target for"))} ${m.y}: CO₂ ≤ ${m.v} Gt · ${L(T("ตอนนี้", "now"))} ${net.toFixed(1)} Gt · ${hit ? L(T("ผ่าน", "reached")) + ` · ${P.IC.ep} +${MS_REWARD.ep} ${P.IC.pc} +${MS_REWARD.pc}` : L(T("ไม่ผ่าน", "missed"))}`, hit ? "gd" : "al");

hook("toast", {id:"ms" + i, icon:hit ? "flag" : "flag-off", title:`${L(T("เป้าหมายปี", "Target"))} ${m.y}`, msg:hit ? L(T("ผ่านแล้ว! ได้เงินและแต้มนโยบาย", "Reached! Money and policy points")) : `${L(T("ไม่ผ่าน", "Missed"))} · ${net.toFixed(1)} / ${m.v} Gt`});
hook("sfx", hit ? "done" : "miss");
const _tick = P.tick;
P.tick = () => { _tick(); if (S.regions && S.started && !S.over){ milestoneTick(); sceneTick(); } };

/* 2.1.7: the final score, item by item, exactly as P.score() adds it up (biggest first), each with its working and
details to open: where the CO₂ was cut, the people behind approval, the countries behind friendship */
P.scoreParts = () => {
const th = S.lang !== "en", win = S.over === "win", TT = P.TOTAL_TICKS || 300, left = Math.max(0, TT - S.tick);
const n = (v, d = 0) => (+v).toLocaleString("en-US", {minimumFractionDigits:d, maximumFractionDigits:d});
const sg = v => (v < 0 ? "−" : "+") + Math.abs(v).toFixed(1);
const net = P.netCO2(), rel = Math.max(0, P.relAll()), tempD = Math.max(0, 2.5 - S.temp);
const regs = S.regions.map(r => ({id:r.id, cut:r.co2_0 - r.co2})).sort((a, b) => b.cut - a.cut);
const cutAll = 36 - net, sinkCut = cutAll - regs.reduce((a, r) => a + r.cut, 0);
const rname = id => L(P.RMETA ? P.RMETA[id].name : (P.REGIONS.find(r => r.id === id) || {}).name);
const whereCO2 = k => [...regs.map(r => ({label:rname(r.id), val:k ? n(r.cut * k) : `${sg(-r.cut)} Gt`, cls:r.cut > 0 ? "good" : "bad"})),
{label:th ? "ป่าและทะเลดูดซับ" : "Forests and oceans", val:k ? n(sinkCut * k) : `${sg(-sinkCut)} Gt`, cls:"good"}];
const parts = [];
if (win){
parts.push({id:"nz", icon:"trophy", raw:5000, label:th ? "Net Zero สำเร็จ" : "Net Zero reached", calc:th ? "โบนัสชนะ" : "win bonus",
note:th ? `CO₂ ที่ลดได้ทั้งหมด ${cutAll.toFixed(1)} Gt มาจาก` : `The ${cutAll.toFixed(1)} Gt cut came from`, det:whereCO2(0)});
parts.push({id:"early", icon:"clock", raw:left * 20, label:th ? "จบก่อนกำหนด" : "Finished early", calc:th ? `${left} เดือน × 20` : `${left} months × 20`,
note:th ? `ถึง Net Zero ${P.dateStr()} เหลือ ${left} เดือนก่อนสิ้นปี 2050` : `Net Zero in ${P.dateStr()}, ${left} months before the end of 2050`, det:[]});
} else {
parts.push({id:"co2", icon:"$co2", raw:cutAll * 80, label:th ? "CO₂ ที่ลดได้" : "CO₂ cut", calc:`${cutAll.toFixed(1)} Gt × 80`,
note:th ? "แต้มจากแต่ละที่ (Gt ที่ลด × 80)" : "Points from each place (Gt cut × 80)", det:whereCO2(80)});
parts.push({id:"nz", icon:"trophy", raw:0, label:th ? "Net Zero ยังไม่สำเร็จ" : "Net Zero not reached", calc:th ? "ถ้าสำเร็จ +5,000" : "+5,000 if reached", miss:1,
note:th ? `ยังเหลือ CO₂ สุทธิ ${net.toFixed(1)} Gt ต่อปี` : `${net.toFixed(1)} Gt a year still left`, det:[]});
parts.push({id:"temp", icon:"thermometer", raw:tempD * 1500, label:th ? "โลกไม่ร้อนเกิน 2.5°C" : "Below 2.5°C", calc:`(2.50 − ${S.temp.toFixed(2)}) × 1,500`,
note:th ? `อุณหภูมิตอนจบ +${S.temp.toFixed(2)}°C ยิ่งต่ำกว่า 2.5°C มาก ยิ่งได้มาก` : `The world ended at +${S.temp.toFixed(2)}°C; the further under 2.5°C, the more points`, det:[]});
const gs = (P.GROUPS || []).filter(g => S.groups && typeof S.groups[g.id] === "number");
parts.push({id:"appr", icon:"$appr", raw:S.appr * 15, label:th ? "ความนิยม" : "Approval", calc:`${S.appr.toFixed(0)}% × 15`,

note:gs.length ? (th ? "ความพอใจแต่ละกลุ่มตอนจบ" : "How each group felt at the end") : "", det:gs.map(g => ({label:L(g.name), val:`${S.groups[g.id].toFixed(0)}%`, cls:S.groups[g.id] >= 50 ? "good" : S.groups[g.id] < 30 ? "bad" : ""}))});
const cs = S.countries.filter(c => !c.rest).slice().sort((a, b) => b.rel - a.rel);
parts.push({id:"rel", icon:"$heart", raw:rel * 10, label:th ? "มิตรภาพทุกประเทศ" : "Friendship", calc:th ? `เฉลี่ย ${rel.toFixed(0)} × 10` : `avg ${rel.toFixed(0)} × 10`,

note:th ? "ประเทศที่สนิทที่สุด / ห่างที่สุด" : "Closest and furthest countries", det:[...cs.slice(0, 3), ...cs.slice(-2)].map(c => ({label:P.cname(c.id), val:c.rel.toFixed(0), cls:c.rel >= 50 ? "good" : c.rel < 0 ? "bad" : ""}))});
// whole points that add up to P.score() exactly (the rounding difference goes to the biggest item)
parts.forEach(p => { p.pts = Math.round(p.raw); });
const total = P.score(), diff = total - parts.reduce((a, p) => a + p.pts, 0);
parts.sort((a, b) => b.pts - a.pts || (a.miss ? 1 : 0) - (b.miss ? 1 : 0));
if (diff && parts[0].pts + diff >= 0) parts[0].pts += diff;
return {parts, total, n};

Version 2.0 · rules
· Fast mode: about 15 minutes (3 s a month at 1×), no minerals and no groups of people, fewer events.
· Yearly review (replaces the 5-year milestones in new games): every January the year that just ended
gets a score 0–100 against the year's CO₂ target. 50+ = a good year: more funding and a little more trust.
Under 50 = a bad year: trust falls. Each year has its own good and bad story (37-data-v20.js).
· The ending depends on how the game ended and how many good years you had (12 endings).
· Training mode support: no saves, no random disasters or events (20-engine.js), scripted from the UI.

/* the target path for net CO₂ (Gt) at a given month: from today's 37 Gt down to 0 at the end of 2050 */
/* path0 · pathK: the target path · span: Gt above/below the target that make a score of 0/100 · rewards for a good year, the penalty for a bad one */
const YR = {path0:37.5, pathK:1.8, span:6, goodEp:4, epPer:.04, goodPc:2, goodAppr:0, badAppr:-.8, floor:45};
const yearTarget = tk => YR.path0 * (1 - Math.pow(clamp(tk / P.TOTAL_TICKS, 0, 1), YR.pathK));
/* the score of the year that ends at month tk: where you are against the target (±SPAN Gt = ±50),
plus up to ±10 for moving faster or slower than the target moved this year */
function yearScore(tk = S.tick){
const net = P.netCO2(), prevTk = Math.max(0, tk - 12), prev = (S.hist[prevTk] || S.hist[0]).net;
const T1 = yearTarget(tk), T0 = yearTarget(prevTk);
const pos = (T1 - net) / YR.span * 50, mom = clamp((prev - net) - (T0 - T1), -1, 1) * 10;
return {score:Math.round(clamp(50 + pos + mom, 0, 100)), net, prev, target:T1, cut:prev - net, need:T0 - T1 + (prev - T0)};
function yearTick(){
if (!S.v2 || S.world || S.over || S.training || S.tick % 12 !== 0 || S.tick === 0) return;
const y = 2025 + S.tick / 12;
S.years = S.years || [];
if (S.years.some(x => x.y === y)) return;
const r = yearScore(), good = r.score >= 50;
const e0 = S.ep, p0 = S.pc, a0 = S.appr;
if (good){ const ep = YR.goodEp + Math.round(r.score * YR.epPer); S.ep += ep; S.pc += YR.goodPc; if (YR.goodAppr) P.addAppr(YR.goodAppr); if (P.ledgerTag) P.ledgerTag("news", ep, YR.goodPc); }
else if (YR.badAppr && S.appr > YR.floor) P.addAppr(Math.max(YR.badAppr, (YR.floor - S.appr) / P.APPR_DOWN));   // trust falls, but a bad year alone never pushes approval under 45%
const rec = {y, s:r.score, g:good ? 1 : 0, net:+r.net.toFixed(2), tgt:+r.target.toFixed(2), cut:+r.cut.toFixed(2), ep:S.ep - e0, pc:S.pc - p0, appr:+(S.appr - a0).toFixed(2)};
S.years.push(rec);

P.addLog(`[[${good ? "trending-up" : "trending-down"}]] ${L(P.UI2.yrTitle)} ${y}: ${r.score}/100 · ${good ? L(P.UI2.yrGood) : L(P.UI2.yrBad)} · CO₂ ${r.net.toFixed(1)} / ${L(P.UI2.yrTarget)} ${r.target.toFixed(1)} Gt`, good ? "gd" : "al");
hook("sfx", good ? "done" : "miss");
hook("yearly", rec);
/* the year the game ended in also counts (a win counts as a good year) */
function finalYear(){
if (!S.v2 || S.world || S.training) return;
S.years = S.years || [];
const y = 2026 + Math.floor((S.tick - 1) / 12);
if (S.years.some(x => x.y === y) || y > 2050) return;
const r = yearScore(), good = S.over === "win" || r.score >= 50;
S.years.push({y, s:S.over === "win" ? Math.max(r.score, 80) : r.score, g:good ? 1 : 0, net:+r.net.toFixed(2), tgt:+r.target.toFixed(2), cut:+r.cut.toFixed(2), last:1});
const goodYears = () => (S.years || []).filter(x => x.g).length;

P.yearStory = rec => { const s = P.YEAR_STORY[rec.y] || P.YEAR_STORY[2050]; return rec.g ? s.good : s.bad; };
P.ending2 = () => { const list = P.END2[S.over] || P.END2.l3; return list[P.endTier(goodYears())]; };
/* 2.1.6: the review window comes every 5 years (2030, 2035 …) and sums up the years since the last one */
const yearSpan = (y, n = 5) => {
const list = (S.years || []).filter(x => x.y > y - n && x.y <= y && !x.last).sort((a, b) => a.y - b.y);
if (!list.length) return null;
const last = list[list.length - 1], ng = list.filter(x => x.g).length, sum = k => list.reduce((a, x) => a + (x[k] || 0), 0);
return {y:last.y, y0:list[0].y, span:list.length, ng, g:ng * 2 >= list.length ? 1 : 0, s:Math.round(sum("s") / list.length),
net:last.net, tgt:last.tgt, cut:+sum("cut").toFixed(2), ep:sum("ep"), pc:sum("pc"), appr:+sum("appr").toFixed(2), list};
const isReviewYear = y => y % 5 === 0;
Object.assign(P, {yearTarget, yearScore, goodYears, yearSpan, isReviewYear, YEAR_RULES:YR});

P.tick = () => { _tick(); if (S.regions && S.started && !S.over) yearTick(); };

3.7.3 · Seasons that matter (they used to change only where disasters strike)
· Energy by season: solar makes more in the hot season and less under monsoon clouds; wind is strongest in the
storm season and in winter. Batteries (E3) halve the dip. Shown as a seasonal swing in world CO₂ (S.seasCO2,
added to gross CO₂ each month, not stored in the regions).
· Summer power peak: air-conditioning pushes CO₂ up in the hot season and the northern summer, and power cuts
cost approval — unless Demand Response (E9) is owned.
· Farming by season: each monsoon brings a good harvest (money) or floods / drought (approval, an aid bubble);
Drought-Proof Crops (A3) and Low-Methane Rice (A1) improve the odds, a hotter world worsens them.
· Seasons get harsher as the world warms (seasonPower): hazard season weights, the power peak and the farming
odds all scale with it.
· Season report: when a season ends it gets a grade A–F (CO₂, approval, disaster damage, aid) and A–B pay a reward.
(The seasonal look of the map is drawn in life.js drawSeason.)

function seasonCO2(id){
const k = seasonPower(), E2 = has("E2") ? 1 : 0, E7 = has("E7") ? 1 : 0, dip = has("E3") ? .5 : 1;
let v = 0;
if (id === "hot") v += -.25 * E2 - .1 * E7;   // strong sun
if (id === "monsoon") v += (.2 * E2 + .1 * E7) * dip;   // clouds
if (id === "storm") v += -.2 * E2;   // strong wind
if (id === "cool") v += -.1 * E2;   // wind
// 3.7.7: air-conditioning / heating no longer add CO₂ every month (it dragged approval down through the whole game);
// the summer peak now only costs a little approval (seasonsTick)
return +v.toFixed(3);

const c = pool[Math.floor(P.rand() * pool.length)];

Lines live in 46-…49-voice-*.js as P.VOICE_LINES[who] = [[key, th, en], …]. Keys:
idle · start (first year) · late (from 2042) · haz:<type> (a disaster anywhere) · home:<type> (in their country)
buy:<energy|industry|nature|city|policy> · apprLow · apprHigh · t15 · t2 (warming passes 1.5 / 2.0°C)
down · up (world CO₂ fell / rose over the last year, said in January) · cool · hot · monsoon · storm (season starts)
Picking is a hash of the month, so it never touches the game's random numbers (balance and the bot tests stay the same).

const hsh = (...a) => { let h = 2166136261; for (const v of a){ const s = String(v); for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++){ h ^= s.charCodeAt(i); h = Math.imul(h, 16777619); } } return (h >>> 0) / 4294967296; };
const COOL = 2, IDLE = 4, KEEP = 4;   // at most one line every 2 months; a quiet line after 4 quiet months; a moment waits up to 4 months for its turn
function state(){
// a new game (or an older save without it): start fresh, counting only what happens from now on

if (!S.vo || S.vo.tk > S.tick) S.vo = {t:-99, tk:S.tick, used:{}, last:{}, pend:[], appr:0, temp:(S.temp >= 1.5 ? 1 : 0) | (S.temp >= 2 ? 2 : 0), owned:null, dmg:((S.stats && S.stats.dmg) || []).length, co2:[]};
S.vo.tk = S.tick;
return S.vo;
/* which moments happened this month (most important first) */
function moments(V){
const out = [];
// disasters that struck this month
const dmg = (S.stats && S.stats.dmg) || [];
for (let i = V.dmg; i < dmg.length; i++){ const d = dmg[i]; out.push({k:"home:" + d.type, c:d.c, pr:9}); out.push({k:"haz:" + d.type, c:d.c, pr:6}); }
V.dmg = dmg.length;
// warming milestones
if (S.temp >= 1.5 && !(V.temp & 1)){ V.temp |= 1; out.push({k:"t15", pr:10}); }
if (S.temp >= 2.0 && !(V.temp & 2)){ V.temp |= 2; out.push({k:"t2", pr:10}); }
// skills bought since last month
const owned = Object.keys(S.owned || {}).filter(k => S.owned[k]);
if (V.owned){ for (const id of owned) if (!V.owned.includes(id) && P.SKILL && P.SKILL[id]) out.push({k:"buy:" + P.SKILL[id].cat, pr:7}); }
V.owned = owned;
// approval crossing a line (once until it comes back)
if (S.appr < 35 && V.appr !== -1){ V.appr = -1; out.push({k:"apprLow", pr:8}); }
else if (S.appr > 75 && V.appr !== 1){ V.appr = 1; out.push({k:"apprHigh", pr:5}); }
else if (S.appr >= 40 && S.appr <= 70) V.appr = 0;
// the year in CO₂, said in January
const net = (S.regions || []).reduce((a, r) => a + r.co2, 0);
V.co2.push(+net.toFixed(2)); if (V.co2.length > 13) V.co2.shift();
if (S.tick % 12 === 0 && V.co2.length >= 13){ const d = V.co2[V.co2.length - 1] - V.co2[0]; if (d < -.4) out.push({k:"down", pr:6}); else if (d > .2) out.push({k:"up", pr:6}); }
// a new season (every other one, so the seasons don't take every turn)
if (P.seasonOf){ const s0 = P.seasonOf(S.tick - 1).id, s1 = P.seasonOf(S.tick).id; if (s0 !== s1 && hsh(S.tick, "sea") < .5) out.push({k:s1, pr:3}); }
const year = 2026 + Math.floor(S.tick / 12);
if (S.tick <= 12 && !V.pend.some(o => o.k === "start")) out.push({k:"start", pr:2});
if (year >= 2042 && !V.pend.some(o => o.k === "late")) out.push({k:"late", pr:2});
// moments wait a few months for their turn (otherwise a disaster in a quiet-down month was never mentioned)
V.pend = (V.pend || []).filter(m => S.tick - m.t <= KEEP);
for (const m of out) if (!V.pend.some(o => o.k === m.k && o.c === m.c)) V.pend.push({...m, t:S.tick});
const now = V.pend.slice();
now.push({k:"idle", pr:1, t:S.tick});
return now.sort((a, b) => b.pr - a.pr || b.t - a.t);
/* who can say this: home lines only for people who live there (or in that region if they have no country) */
function speakers(m){
const L = P.VOICE_LINES, out = [];
for (const who of Object.keys(L)){
const n = P.NPC[who]; if (!n) continue;
if (!L[who].some(l => l[0] === m.k)) continue;
if (m.k.startsWith("home:")){
const cc = P.C ? P.C(m.c) : null;
if (n.home ? n.home !== m.c : !(cc && n.reg && cc.reg === n.reg)) continue;
out.push(who);
return out;
function say(){
if (!S.started || S.over || S.simple || S.mp || S.training) return;
const V = state(), list = moments(V);
const quiet = S.tick - V.t;
if (quiet < COOL) return;
for (const m of list){
if (m.k === "idle" && quiet < IDLE) continue;
if ((m.k === "start" || m.k === "late") && quiet < IDLE - 1) continue;
if (m.k.startsWith("haz:") && list.some(x => x.k === "home:" + m.k.slice(4) && speakers(x).length)) continue;   // someone who lives there speaks instead
const who = speakers(m); if (!who.length) continue;
// the person who spoke least lately, then a line they haven't said yet
who.sort((a, b) => (V.last[a] ?? -99) - (V.last[b] ?? -99) || hsh(S.tick, a) - hsh(S.tick, b));
const w = who[0], lines = P.VOICE_LINES[w].map((l, i) => [l, i]).filter(([l]) => l[0] === m.k);
const fresh = lines.filter(([, i]) => !V.used[w + i]), pool = fresh.length ? fresh : lines;
const [line, i] = pool[Math.floor(hsh(S.tick, w, m.k) * pool.length)];
if (!fresh.length) for (const [, j] of lines) delete V.used[w + j];   // all said: start the set again
V.used[w + i] = 1; V.last[w] = S.tick; V.t = S.tick;
V.pend = V.pend.filter(o => o.k !== m.k && !(m.k.startsWith("home:") && o.k === "haz:" + m.k.slice(5) && o.c === m.c) && !(m.k.startsWith("haz:") && o.k === "home:" + m.k.slice(4) && o.c === m.c));
hook("voice", {who:w, name:P.NPC[w].name, color:P.NPC[w].color, th:line[1], en:line[2], k:m.k, c:m.c || null});
return;
const _tick = P.tick;
P.tick = () => { _tick(); try { say(); } catch (e){ if (typeof console !== "undefined") console.error(e); } };

["start", "มีผู้นำโลกคนใหม่แล้วเหรอ ลุงขอให้มาดูนาลุงสักครั้งก่อนตัดสินใจอะไร", "A new world leader? I'd ask you to come and see my field once before you decide anything."],
["start", "ลุงไม่รู้ว่า Net Zero คืออะไร แต่ถ้าแปลว่าน้ำเค็มจะไม่ขึ้นมาอีก ลุงเอาด้วย", "I don't know what Net Zero means, but if it means the salt stops coming up, I'm for it."],
["start", "ยี่สิบห้าปีนะ ลุงก็อายุเจ็ดสิบแปดพอดี อยากเห็นวันนั้นจริง ๆ", "Twenty-five years. I'll be seventy-eight. I really want to see that day."],
["start", "ช่วงแรกคนจะบ่นเยอะ ลุงรู้ เพราะลุงก็บ่น แต่ลุงจะรอดู", "People will grumble at first. I know, because I grumble too. But I'll wait and see."],
["start", "ปีแรกของผู้นำคนใหม่ ลุงขอแค่ฟังคนตัวเล็กบ้าง", "In your first year, just listen to the small people now and then."],
// late game
["late", "ลุงแก่แล้ว แต่ยังได้เห็นทุ่งนาเขียวอยู่ ขอบใจที่ไม่ปล่อยให้มันกลายเป็นทะเล", "I'm old now, but the fields are still green. Thank you for not letting them become sea."],
["late", "หลานลุงเรียนจบเกษตรแล้ว กลับมาทำนาที่บ้าน ลุงไม่เคยคิดว่าจะได้เห็น", "My grandson graduated in agriculture and came home to farm. I never thought I'd see that."],
["late", "อีกไม่กี่ปีก็ 2050 แล้ว ลุงอยากให้วันนั้นเป็นวันที่บอกหลานได้ว่าเราทำได้", "2050 is only a few years off. I want it to be the day I tell my grandson we made it."],
["late", "ทุกวันนี้ลุงไม่ต้องจุ่มเครื่องวัดเค็มทุกเช้าแล้ว จุ่มอาทิตย์ละครั้งพอ", "These days I don't dip the salt meter every morning. Once a week is enough."],
["late", "นาข้างบ้านที่เคยเป็นบ่อกุ้ง กลับมาปลูกข้าวได้แล้ว ลุงดีใจแทนเพื่อน", "The shrimp pond next door is a rice field again. I'm happy for my neighbour."],
// disasters at home
["home:flood", "น้ำท่วมนาลุงมิดหัวเข่าแล้ว ข้าวเพิ่งตั้งท้อง ปีนี้คงได้ไม่ถึงครึ่ง", "The water's knee-deep in my field. The rice had just set grain. I'll be lucky to get half."],
["home:flood", "ลุงย้ายวัวขึ้นถนนแล้ว ที่บ้านยังพอนอนได้ แต่ใจมันนอนไม่หลับ", "I've moved the cow up to the road. The house is still dry enough to sleep in, but I can't sleep."],
["home:flood", "น้ำปีนี้มาเร็วกว่าที่กรมชลประทานบอก ฝนตกหนักทีเดียวเท่าตกทั้งเดือน", "The water came faster than irrigation said. One downpour was a month's rain."],
["home:flood", "น้ำท่วมนาไม่ได้แย่เสมอไปนะ มันพาตะกอนมา แต่ถ้ามันไม่ลดสักที ข้าวก็เน่า", "A flood isn't always bad. It brings silt. But if it never drains, the rice rots."],
["home:flood", "ลุงต่อเรือไว้ลำหนึ่งตั้งแต่ปี 54 ไม่คิดว่าจะได้ใช้บ่อยขนาดนี้", "I built a boat after the 2011 flood. Never thought I'd use it this often."],
["home:flood", "เพื่อนบ้านมาช่วยกันกั้นกระสอบทราย ลุงว่าน้ำท่วมทำให้คนรักกันมากขึ้นนะ", "The neighbours came to stack sandbags. Floods make people closer, I think."],
["home:flood", "ถ้าเมืองใหญ่ระบายน้ำมาทางทุ่งเรา ก็ขอให้จ่ายค่าเสียหายให้ชาวนาด้วย", "If the big city drains its water through our fields, at least pay the farmers for it."],
["home:flood", "ข้าวลอยน้ำพันธุ์เก่าของปู่ยังมีอยู่ในยุ้ง ปีหน้าลุงจะปลูกแปลงหนึ่ง เผื่อไว้", "Grandpa's old floating rice is still in the barn. Next year I'll plant a plot, just in case."],
["home:saltwater", "เครื่องวัดขึ้นสองกรัมต่อลิตรแล้ว ข้าวทนได้ไม่เกินนี้ ลุงต้องปิดประตูน้ำ", "The meter reads two grams per litre. Rice can't take more. I have to shut the sluice."],
["home:saltwater", "น้ำเค็มขึ้นมาถึงนาแล้ว ข้าวตายทั้งแปลง ลุงทำนามาสี่สิบปีไม่เคยเห็น", "The salt water reached the field. The whole plot died. Forty years farming and I've never seen it."],
["home:saltwater", "ใบข้าวเหลืองจากปลายเข้ามา นั่นแหละอาการโดนเค็ม ลุงดูออกแล้วตอนนี้", "Leaves yellowing from the tip inward. That's salt. I can spot it now."],

["home:saltwater", "แม่น้ำบางปะกงน้ำน้อย ทะเลก็ดันเข้ามาลึกขึ้นทุกปี มันเกินกว่าที่คนรุ่นลุงจะรับไหว", "The Bang Pakong runs low and the sea pushes further up each year. It's more than my generation can bear."],
["home:saltwater", "ลุงขุดสระเก็บน้ำฝนไว้ใช้ตอนน้ำในคลองเค็ม ใครมีที่ ลุงแนะนำให้ขุด", "I dug a pond to store rainwater for when the canal turns salty. If you have land, dig one."],
["home:saltwater", "น้ำเค็มไม่ได้แค่ฆ่าข้าว มันฆ่าต้นมะม่วง ฆ่าสวนผัก ลามไปทั้งหมู่บ้าน", "Salt doesn't just kill rice. It kills the mango trees and the vegetable plots. The whole village."],
["home:saltwater", "ลูกชายลุงโทรมาบอกให้ขายนา ลุงยังไม่ยอม นาผืนนี้ปู่ลุงเปิดมากับมือ", "My son called to say sell. I won't yet. My grandfather cleared this field with his own hands."],
["home:saltwater", "ถ้ามีประตูกั้นน้ำเค็มที่ปากแม่น้ำ ลุงว่าคุ้มกว่าแจกเงินชดเชยทุกปีนะ", "A salt barrier at the river mouth would be worth more than paying compensation every year."],
["home:saltwater", "ดินเค็มไปแล้วต้องใช้เวลาล้างหลายปี เหมือนแผลที่หายช้า", "Once soil turns salty it takes years to wash out. Like a wound that heals slowly."],
["home:saltwater", "ลุงลองปลูกข้าวพันธุ์ กข ทนเค็มแปลงหนึ่งแล้ว ขึ้นได้ ยังมีหวัง", "I tried the salt-tolerant RD variety on one plot. It grew. There's still hope."],
["home:drought", "ปีนี้แล้ง ลุงต้องสูบน้ำบาดาลมาใช้ ค่าไฟขึ้นเท่าตัว", "A dry year. I'm pumping groundwater and my electricity bill has doubled."],
["home:drought", "ดินแตกระแหงจนเอามือสอดได้ ลุงเลยยังไม่หว่าน รอฝนก่อน", "The ground's cracked wide enough to put your hand in. I'm not sowing until it rains."],
["home:drought", "แล้งปีนี้ทำให้น้ำทะเลรุกเข้ามาอีก แล้งกับเค็มมาคู่กันเสมอ", "This drought lets the sea come further in. Drought and salt always come together."],
["home:drought", "ทางการขอให้งดทำนาปรัง ลุงเข้าใจ แต่ไม่ทำนาแล้วลุงจะกินอะไร", "They've asked us to skip the dry-season crop. I understand, but what do I eat?"],
["home:drought", "ลุงปลูกถั่วแทนข้าวในหน้าแล้ง ใช้น้ำน้อยกว่า ดินก็ได้ไนโตรเจนด้วย", "I grow beans instead of rice in the dry season. Less water, and the soil gets nitrogen."],
["home:drought", "เขื่อนเหลือน้ำไม่ถึงยี่สิบเปอร์เซ็นต์ ลุงไม่เคยเห็นตัวเลขนี้มาก่อน", "The dam is under twenty percent. I've never seen that number before."],
["home:drought", "ลุงตักน้ำรดต้นกล้าทีละถัง หลังจะหักแล้ว แต่ต้นกล้าต้องรอด", "I water the seedlings bucket by bucket. My back is breaking, but the seedlings must live."],
["home:drought", "ฝนทิ้งช่วงสามสัปดาห์ ข้าวที่ปลูกไปเริ่มเหลือง ลุงได้แต่ภาวนา", "Three weeks without rain. The rice is yellowing. All I can do is pray."],
["home:heat", "ร้อนจนลุงต้องออกนาตอนตีสี่ พอสิบโมงก็ต้องกลับ ไม่งั้นเป็นลม", "So hot I go out at four in the morning and come back by ten, or I'll faint."],
["home:heat", "คนงานรับจ้างดำนาขอขึ้นค่าแรง เพราะร้อนจนทำได้ไม่ถึงครึ่งวัน ลุงก็เห็นใจ", "The day labourers want more pay. It's too hot to work half a day. I understand."],
["home:heat", "วัวลุงหอบทั้งวัน ลุงต้องราดน้ำให้มันทุกชั่วโมง", "My cow pants all day. I pour water on her every hour."],
["home:heat", "ปลาในบ่อลอยตายเพราะน้ำร้อน ปีก่อนไม่เคยเป็นแบบนี้", "The fish in my pond floated up dead. The water got too hot. That never used to happen."],
["home:heat", "ร้อนแบบนี้ ดอกข้าวไม่ผสมเกสร ข้าวทั้งรวงจะลีบ ลุงกลัวที่สุดก็ตรงนี้", "In heat like this the rice flowers don't pollinate and whole heads come out empty. That's my biggest fear."],
["home:heat", "ลุงสร้างเพิงมุงจากไว้กลางนา ให้คนงานได้หลบแดด ไม่ต้องใช้แอร์ก็เย็น", "I built a thatched shelter in the field so the workers can rest out of the sun. Cool without air-con."],
// disasters elsewhere
["haz:typhoon", "เห็นข่าวพายุที่ฟิลิปปินส์แล้วใจหาย ชาวนาที่นั่นก็เหมือนลุงนี่แหละ", "Seeing the storm in the Philippines broke my heart. The farmers there are just like me."],
["haz:flood", "น้ำท่วมที่อื่นก็ทำให้ข้าวแพงขึ้นทั่วโลกนะ ลุงขายได้ราคาดี แต่ไม่ดีใจเลย", "Floods elsewhere push rice prices up everywhere. I sell at a good price, but I'm not glad."],
["haz:drought", "แล้งที่อินเดียทีไร ราคาข้าวขึ้นทุกที แต่คนจนทั่วโลกต้องกินแพงขึ้น", "Whenever India has a drought, rice prices jump. And poor people everywhere pay more to eat."],
["haz:heat", "ฟังข่าวว่าที่อื่นร้อนถึงห้าสิบองศา ลุงว่าที่นี่สี่สิบก็จะแย่แล้ว", "They say it reached fifty degrees somewhere. Forty here already feels like too much."],
["haz:wildfire", "ไฟป่าที่ไหนก็ตาม ควันมันลอยมาถึงนาลุงได้นะ ฟ้าเป็นสีส้มทั้งวัน", "Wherever the fires are, the smoke can reach my field. The sky's orange all day."],
["haz:saltwater", "ได้ข่าวว่าที่เวียดนามก็โดนน้ำเค็มเหมือนกัน ลุงอยากคุยกับชาวนาที่นั่นจัง", "I hear Vietnam has the salt problem too. I'd love to talk to the farmers there."],
// skills
["buy:nature", "ข้าวทนเค็มกับทุนให้ชาวนาปรับตัว แบบนี้แหละที่ลุงรอมานาน", "Salt-tolerant rice and money for farmers to adapt. This is what I've been waiting for."],
["buy:nature", "เกษตรฟื้นฟูดินเหรอ ลุงทำอยู่แล้ว แค่ไม่มีใครให้ชื่อมันเท่านั้นเอง", "Regenerative farming? I've done it for years. Nobody had given it a name, that's all."],
["buy:nature", "ปลูกป่าชายเลนเพิ่มดีนะ มันเป็นกำแพงกันน้ำเค็มที่ราคาถูกที่สุด", "More mangroves are good. They're the cheapest wall against salt water there is."],
["buy:nature", "ทำนาแบบปล่อยมีเทนน้อย ถ้ามีคนมาสอน ลุงยินดีลองทั้งหมู่บ้าน", "Low-methane rice farming? If someone comes to teach us, the whole village will try."],
["buy:nature", "พืชทนแล้งมาแล้ว ปีหน้าลุงจะได้ไม่ต้องลุ้นฝนจนนอนไม่หลับ", "Drought-proof crops! Next year I won't lie awake hoping for rain."],
["buy:nature", "ปลูกต้นไม้ทั่วโลกก็ดี แต่อย่าลืมว่าคนปลูกส่วนใหญ่คือชาวบ้านอย่างลุง", "Planting trees around the world is good. Don't forget most of the planting is done by people like me."],
["buy:nature", "ไบโอชาร์จากฟางข้าว ลุงเผาถ่านแบบปิดได้ ดีกว่าเผาฟางทิ้งกลางนาเยอะ", "Biochar from rice straw? I can char it in a closed kiln. Much better than burning it in the field."],
["buy:nature", "ชลประทานแบบใหม่ส่งน้ำถึงปลายคลองได้ ลุงอยู่ปลายคลองพอดี", "The new irrigation reaches the far end of the canal. That's exactly where I am."],
["buy:energy", "ไฟฟ้าสะอาดดีนะ แต่อย่าให้ค่าไฟแพงจนชาวนาสูบน้ำไม่ไหว", "Clean power is good, but don't let the bill get so high that farmers can't pump water."],
["buy:energy", "ถ้ามีโซลาร์ฟาร์มมาตั้งข้างนา ลุงขอให้จ้างคนในหมู่บ้านด้วยนะ", "If a solar farm goes up next to the fields, hire people from the village."],
["buy:energy", "ลมแรงทุ่งนี้ทั้งปี ถ้ามีกังหันลมสักต้น ลุงยกมือเอาด้วย", "The wind blows across this plain all year. Put up a turbine and I'll vote for it."],
["buy:energy", "ลุงอ่านข่าวว่าไฟฟ้าจากแดดถูกกว่าถ่านหินแล้ว ทำไมไม่รีบใช้กันล่ะ", "I read that solar power is cheaper than coal now. Why aren't we hurrying?"],
["buy:energy", "แบตเตอรี่เก็บไฟไว้ใช้กลางคืน ลุงจะได้สูบน้ำตอนเย็นที่ไม่ร้อน", "Batteries to store power for the night. I can pump water in the cool of the evening."],
["buy:city", "เมืองฟองน้ำเหรอ ดีนะ ถ้าเมืองเก็บน้ำเองได้ จะได้ไม่ระบายมาท่วมนาลุง", "Sponge cities? Good. If the city keeps its own water, it won't drain it onto my field."],
["buy:city", "เตือนภัยล่วงหน้าดีมาก ปีที่แล้วลุงรู้ก่อนสามวัน ย้ายวัวทันพอดี", "Early warnings are great. Last year I knew three days ahead and moved the cow in time."],
["buy:city", "กำแพงกันทะเลช่วยเมืองได้ แต่น้ำมันจะไปไหนล่ะ อย่ามาท่วมนาแทนก็แล้วกัน", "Sea walls protect the city. But where does the water go then? Not onto the fields, I hope."],
["buy:city", "ทุนช่วยคนทิ้งบ้านหนีน้ำเค็ม ลุงยังไม่ไปหรอก แต่รู้ว่ามีทางเลือกก็อุ่นใจ", "Help for people who have to leave the salt behind. I'm not going yet, but it's good to know."],
["buy:city", "ถนนในหมู่บ้านยกสูงแล้ว น้ำท่วมทีหน้าลูกหลานยังขี่มอเตอร์ไซค์ไปโรงเรียนได้", "The village road's been raised. Next flood, the kids can still ride to school."],
["buy:industry", "ปุ๋ยจากไฮโดรเจนสีเขียว ถ้าราคาถูกลง ลุงเปลี่ยนทันที", "Fertiliser made with green hydrogen? If it gets cheaper, I'll switch at once."],
["buy:industry", "รถไฟความเร็วสูงผ่านฉะเชิงเทรา ลูกลุงจะได้กลับบ้านบ่อยขึ้น", "High-speed rail through Chachoengsao. My son can come home more often."],
["buy:industry", "รถไถไฟฟ้าราคายังแพงอยู่ ถ้ารัฐช่วยครึ่งหนึ่ง ลุงซื้อแน่", "Electric tractors are still pricey. If the state pays half, I'll buy one."],
["buy:industry", "โรงงานใกล้บ้านเลิกปล่อยควันดำแล้ว ผ้าที่ป้าตากไว้ไม่เป็นคราบอีก", "The factory nearby stopped pumping black smoke. My wife's washing doesn't get stained anymore."],
["buy:policy", "ภาษีคาร์บอนนี่ ใครปล่อยมากก็จ่ายมาก ฟังแล้วยุติธรรมดีนะ", "A carbon tax: the more you pollute, the more you pay. Sounds fair to me."],
["buy:policy", "ข้อตกลงระหว่างประเทศดีแล้ว ขอแค่มีบรรทัดหนึ่งพูดถึงชาวนาด้วย", "International agreements are fine. Just put one line in about farmers."],
["buy:policy", "กองทุนความสูญเสียเหรอ ลุงขอให้เงินมาถึงคนที่เสียจริง ไม่ใช่ติดอยู่ข้างบน", "A loss and damage fund? Let the money reach the people who lost, not get stuck at the top."],
["buy:policy", "ถ้าทุกประเทศตกลงกันได้ น้ำเค็มก็ไม่ต้องรอใครตกลงหรอก มันมาของมันเอง ต้องรีบ", "Even if every country agrees, the salt won't wait for the signatures. Hurry."],
// approval, warming, the year
["apprLow", "คนในหมู่บ้านเริ่มบ่นว่าผู้นำไม่ฟังชาวบ้าน ลุงบอกเขาว่ารอดูอีกหน่อย", "People in the village say the leader doesn't listen. I told them to wait a little longer."],
["apprLow", "ลุงไม่ได้โกรธนะ แค่เหนื่อย เหนื่อยที่ต้องรอข่าวดีมานาน", "I'm not angry. Just tired. Tired of waiting so long for good news."],
["apprLow", "ถ้าจะให้ชาวบ้านเชื่อ ต้องให้เขาเห็นอะไรเปลี่ยนในนาของเขาเองก่อน", "If you want villagers to believe, let them see something change in their own fields first."],
["apprHigh", "ทั้งตำบลพูดถึงผู้นำคนนี้ ว่าเป็นคนแรกที่พูดถึงน้ำเค็มเหมือนรู้จริง", "The whole district talks about you, the first leader who speaks about salt water like you know it."],

["t15", "เขาว่าโลกร้อนเกินหนึ่งจุดห้าองศาแล้ว ลุงไม่ต้องดูตัวเลข ลุงรู้จากนา", "They say the world passed one point five degrees. I didn't need the number. My field told me."],

Left: hexagon grid of the selected category · Right: details of the tapped skill · Bottom: category tabs
Opening it pauses the game. Close with ✕, Esc, T, or by tapping outside the window.
Only owned skills and the NEXT skills you can buy are shown; anything further away is "???".
const {Kit, S, t, L, Audio, W, UIM, Screens, SKILLS, SKILL, SKILL_CATS, SKILL_TYPE, IC, HAZARDS} = P;
const k = Kit;
// 2.1.3: a full-screen page like the website (ui/skills.jsx + .skills-page): header · grid (left) + details (380, right) · category tabs
let HEXR = 50, COLW = 168, ROWH = 142, SC = 1;
const hexPts = (cx, cy, r) => { const p = []; for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++){ const a = Math.PI / 180 * (60 * i - 30); p.push(cx + r * Math.cos(a), cy + r * Math.sin(a)); } return p; };
/* 2.1.5: the part of a hexagon's outline (same corners as hexPts) that is done, f = 0 → 1, as a polyline */
const ringPath = (cx, cy, r, f) => { const v = i => { const a = Math.PI / 180 * (60 * i - 30); return [cx + r * Math.cos(a), cy + r * Math.sin(a)]; };

const out = v(0), segs = Math.min(1, f) * 6; for (let i = 1; i <= Math.ceil(segs); i++){ const a = v(i - 1), b = v(i), u = Math.min(1, segs - (i - 1)); out.push(a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * u, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * u); } return out; };
const centre = n => [OX + cx0(n) * SC, OY + cy0(n) * SC];
/* "next" = all requirements owned; anything further away is dimmed with a lock (name and picture visible, like web 2.1) */
const visible = n => S.owned[n.id] || n.req.every(q => S.owned[q]);
const typeTags = n => {
const out = [];
out.push(n.type === "active" ? "active" : "passive");
if (n.trade) out.push("trade");
if (n.resp) out.push("resp");
if (n.target === "country") out.push("country");
return out;

{ const g = l.g0; g.lineStyle(0); for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++){ const f = 1 - i / 14; g.beginFill(0x10303a, .07); g.drawEllipse(k.W / 2 * k.K, 0, k.W * .75 * f * k.K, k.H * .9 * f * k.K); g.endFill(); } }
